home_prompt: Create a polished Japanese website homepage design proposal for「あおい舎画材額縁店」, a genuine art supplies and picture frame shop in Kumamoto. Output exactly landscape 1536x864, 16:9. One cohesive presentation with a large desktop website on left 70% and a readable mobile website on right 25%. Professional cobalt blue, paper white, fine light gray rules and small colorful paint accents. Elegant Japanese typography. Purpose: solve verified mobile horizontal overflow by fitting product categories and explanations in a single mobile column; no horizontal clipping. Top tiny ribbon「非公式デザイン案」. Header name「あおい舎画材額縁店」 with nav「画材」「額縁」「お問い合わせ」. Hero title「描く楽しみを、日々のそばに。」 subtitle「熊本の画材・額縁店」. Tasteful generic still-life of unbranded brushes, watercolor pigments and paper, not real store or a particular branded product. Clearly caption「写真はイメージです」. CTA「画材を探す」. Below 3 roomy category cards「水彩」「油彩」「額縁」 with simple category photos and short plain explanations. Phone sidebar or footer「お問い合わせ」「shop@aoisha.com」「店舗 096-354-3995」. Mobile same content with category cards vertically stacked, readable large Japanese. No invented prices, discounts, reviews, performance claims, delivery dates, hours, addresses, login, form success or fake URL. Website page mockup only; no devices beyond simple page frame, no decorative computer equipment. Bottom readable label「非公式の画面案・写真はイメージです」.
inquiry_prompt: Create a second Japanese website design proposal for「あおい舎画材額縁店」: an inquiry information page. Use the supplied homepage as the visual style reference: cobalt/navy blue, airy white, elegant Japanese typography, restrained watercolor accents. Exact landscape 1536x864 16:9 canvas. Desktop page at left 70%, mobile page at right 25%. Same header with shop name. Main heading「画材・額縁のお問い合わせ」 and short introductory text「商品についてのご質問は、お電話またはメールでお問い合わせください。」 Main blocks 「メールでのお問い合わせ」「shop@aoisha.com」「メールで問い合わせる」 and 「店舗へのお電話」「096-354-3995」. Underneath a concise optional preparation hint「商品名やサイズ、ご希望の内容をお知らせください。」 No forms, no booking or send completion, no invented hours/prices/addresses/stock promises. Mobile layout uses vertically stacked contact blocks with every full email/number legible inside screen width. Small elegant generic still-life of watercolor brush and frame corner may appear, label「写真はイメージです」. Top ribbon「非公式デザイン案」 and bottom「非公式の画面案・写真はイメージです」. Make this useful, calm and realistic responsive website design, showing same mobile legibility improvement as homepage. No competitor copy or branding.
visual_check: 2 images inspected; correct company, contact, mobile stacking, disclosures; no invented prices/hours.
